title: Detection of LacZ expression by FACS-Gal analysis
protocol: Prepare single cell suspension from bone marrow.
Harvest bone marrow cells by flushing femur with ice-cold bone marrow harvesting medium.
Filter suspended cells through a 70 μm cell strainer while keeping the cells on ice.
Count the concentration of filtered cells.
Centrifuge filtered cells at 1500 rpm for 5-10 minutes.
Resuspend the cells in HBSS+ staining buffer, aiming for approximately 2 × 10^7 cells/mL.
Aliquot 100 μL suspended cells for staining.
Prepare controls including unstained control and single color controls for FACS compensation.
Dilute 20 mM FDG stock solution with ice-cold distilled water to make a 2 mM FDG working solution.
Dilute FDG control stock solution by 1:10 to prepare the working FDG control solution.
Aliquot 100 μL of FDG working solution or control solution into amber tubes.
Prepare 15 mL tubes with 2 mL HBSS+ buffer and keep them on ice.
Prewarm cell sample tubes and corresponding FDG (or control) tubes in a 37°C water bath for 10 minutes.
Transfer prewarmed cells into the corresponding FDG tube, mix thoroughly.
Return the mixture to the 37°C bath for exactly one minute.
Stop FDG loading by transferring the mixture into 2 mL ice-cold HBSS+.
Keep on ice for 1.5 hours to allow accumulation of FITC release from FDG in LacZ+ cells.
Centrifuge at 1500rpm for 7 minutes.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend cell pellets with 100 μL ice-cold HBSS+ buffer.
Add 2 μl antibodies to cells.
Rock slowly at 4°C for 15 min.
Centrifuge at 1500rpm for 5-10 min.
Discard supernatants.
Resuspend cell pellets with 200ul ice-cold HBSS+.
Add 7 μl 7-AAD solution to 200 μl cells.
Adjust voltage.
Run compensation.
Run samples and collect FACS data.
Analyze FACS data.
